subject: [PATCH 06/60] mm/memory_hotplug: migrate offlined pages to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Identified a double-put bug in fuse_try_move_page() where the folio refcount drops to zero prematurely. Suggested adding an extra folio_get() before replace_page_cache_folio() to maintain the reference.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to migrate offlined pages to common memory, addressing an issue where the destination nodemask becomes empty due to partial offlining. The problem arises when a node is partially offlined and its corresponding mask is removed from the destination nodemask. To fix this, the hot-unplug migration target-list is restricted to N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes, ensuring that only eligible allocation targets are considered.
